local_device.invariant: only a single A-Z drive letter followed by ':' launches the helper

slave_command.invariant: only a valid drive letter plus command terminator reaches DefineDosDevice

dos_device.invariant: device name is a documented drive-letter MS-DOS device

contracts: LaunchSlave validates the local device drive letter before creating the helper command
RunSlave validates the command drive letter before DefineDosDevice
RunSlave requires a command terminator after the drive letter
DefineDosDevice receives an uppercase drive-letter device name
This SREV preserves NetUseAdd policy and success-only LaunchSlave behavior
runtime_gate: Windows service build plus valid mapped-drive broadcast and malformed NetProxy command smoke
